{{Quote|I used to be a part of the Rebel Alliance Spy Network, but I decided that my skills were needed elsewhere. I collected information for them regarding the activity on Lok. Obviously, they didn't like the fact that their systems were easy to hack. I left on account of 'unresolved differences'.|Talia v'laenya, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:Tv" />}}
'''Talia v'laenya''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Early during the conflict, she joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and was a member of the [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Spy Network]]. However, she left the organization due to "unresolved differences" prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:Tv" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> she operated out of [[Nym's Stronghold]] on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]. There, she encountered a spacer and provided information about [[Kimogila Town]] and the [[Canyon Corsair's Stronghold]].<ref name="SWG:Tv" />

==Behind the scenes==
Talia v'laenya was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:Tv" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Talia v'laenya was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 5 Notes: 16 December 03|Publish 5]]" update, released on [[December 16]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 5: Vehicles">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60892|text=Publish 5: Vehicles}}</ref>
